owner: Evrisho, joint venture of Hyosung Heavy Industries and STT GDC
notes: Hankook Ilbo (2023-02-13) reports the Evrisho JV (Hyosung Heavy Industries and Singapore's STT GDC) planned an IDC on a 12,627 sqm site in Hogye-dong, Anyang-si with a 62 m tall, two-basement/eight-above-ground-floor building, but faced intense resident opposition (banners, petitions and inspections requests) as of February 2023; Anyang city said procedures were lawful. Project status beyond planning could not be confirmed in later public sources; treated as planned with opposition risk.
